# AL1400: Method with [AotTest] or [TrimTest] must return int

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Error |
| Category | `AOT Testing` |

| Analyzer | `Al1400AotTestMustReturnIntAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Methods decorated with [AotTest] or [TrimTest] attributes must return int as their exit code. The test harness expects an integer return value to determine success or failure.
